scope: Actual RewardCatalog, RewardLedger and RewardStore execute with real host JSON parsing. Only Android Context/SharedPreferences I/O is simulated, including failed writes. This does not establish Android gameplay, native bonus application or device persistence.

walletPolicy.savedRuns: Pinned runs hold unused reservations; suspended runs permit other Home purchases.
walletPolicy.livePurchases: Reserve money first; stable pending UUID; commit only native applied journal proof; refund only explicit clean rejection, never unknown timeout or partial effects.
walletPolicy.savedResume: Wave IDs, completion-paid history, consumed quotas and transaction journal remain monotonic across reload. Returned stock is reclaimed only if still in the bank.
